hints.title: Square Root Decomposition Threshold
hints.text: When step size y is large (y >= sqrt(N)), there are at most sqrt(N) terms to sum directly.

hints.title: Precalculating Small Step Sizes
hints.text: When step size y is small (y < sqrt(N)), precompute suffix sums table[y][x] = nums[x] + table[y][x + y] modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Answering Queries Dynamically
hints.text: For each query (x, y), look up table[y][x] if y < B, otherwise iterate directly summing nums[x + k * y].

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Threshold B = sqrt(N) balances precomputation time and online query evaluation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating every query by linear iteration takes O(Q * N) time, causing time limit exceeded.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Storing prefix tables for small steps consumes O(N * sqrt(N)) memory to bound query time to O(sqrt(N)).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Square root threshold decomposition splitting small and large step sizes.
